Hi Oliver — thanks for sending the CSV. I reviewed the logs with our incident team and confirmed a regional routing regression caused degraded responses for ~232 minutes aggregate (we break this into two windows for detection/mitigation).

High level: per Redwood's SLA (v2.1) for Dedicated/Committed customers, eligibility is evaluated on monthly uptime percentage. Initial calc shows your Aug month uptime = 99.48% which is below the 99.95% target. That makes Nimbus eligible for a service offset.

We're preparing a formal computation and will route it through finance for issuance. Quick questions for AP: do you prefer a) an invoice adjustment to Aug invoice, b) a credit applied to the next invoice, or c) a one-time payout/offset? We typically do option (b) unless customers request otherwise.

I'll attach our calculation workbook once the numbers are finalized and will loop in Markus from Finance to confirm accounting treatment.

—Evelyn
Evelyn Hart

Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-07T11:16:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Service offset calc for Nimbus — draft attached

Folks — draft calculation attached (service-credit-calc-0807.xlsx). Key assumptions used:
- Month: August 2026 (31 days = 44,640 minutes)
- Total customer-observed downtime (minutes): 232
- Uptime = (44,640 - 232) / 44,640 = 99.48%
- SLA bands (per contract v2.1):
  * >= 99.95% — no credit
  * 99.00% to <99.95% — credit = 10% of monthly committed spend
  * 95.00% to <99.00% — credit = 25%
  * <95.00% — credit = 50%
- Nimbus committed monthly spend used for calc: $42,500

Result: 99.48% places Nimbus in the 10% band -> proposed credit = $4,250.

Accounting note: Our policy is to issue an account credit applied to the next invoice unless customer requests immediate invoice adjustment. For larger credits (> $10k) we require VP Finance sign-off; this one is below that threshold so can be approved by Finance Manager.

Markus — can you confirm? I'll send a short note to Nimbus with the formal calc and request confirmation of preferred credit application method.

Thanks,
Marissa
Director, Customer Reliability Operations
Redwood Inference
